# synthetic-probe

> Synthetic HTTP probes in Go with typed failure reasons, capped body reads, an injected clock and doer, and a rolling SLO tracker with error budget remaining Go module `github.com/Trysac/u235-synthetic-probe`, package `syntheticprobe`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
